author: Pruvot-Fol, 1947

familyName.es: Babosas de mar chupadoras de savia

note.en: A sap-sucking slug that feeds on Halimeda algae, known here from five museum specimens from Punta Uva, Punta Piuta and Manzanillo, 4 to 15 m, in 1999 to 2003.
note.es: Una babosa chupadora de savia que come el alga Halimeda, conocida aquí por cinco ejemplares de museo de Punta Uva, Punta Piuta y Manzanillo, entre 4 y 15 m, de 1999 a 2003.

evidence: GBIF: 5 museum specimens, Punta Uva, Punta Piuta, Manzanillo, 1999 to 2003

sources.t: WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and distribution

recWhy: Museum specimens from Punta Uva, Punta Piuta, Manzanillo.
